architecture: Compact Temporal Fusion Transformer: variable-selection networks (enc/dec), LSTM encoder-decoder, 1-head attention, gated residual networks, d_model=32, quantile head
device: GPU: NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti Laptop (4 GB), torch 2.14.1+cu130
